description: The National Audit Office published the raw data behind its managing flood risk data visualisation as downloadable CSV files, as an accessible alternative to the tool. The files summarise flood defences and their condition by region and by upper-tier local authority, capital spend on flood defences split between government and local levy funding by region and authority, homes better protected by completed capital projects up to April 2020, and properties at risk of flooding by parliamentary constituency and lower-tier authority, at annual risk thresholds above 1 percent and above 0.1 percent. Defence locations and condition, funding and property counts come from the Environment Agency, and the Environment Agency adjusted the 2016 risk figures for a 2018 methodology change. Coverage: England, area summaries, not asset-level records. Access: free CSV downloads; the licence is not stated on the page read. Caveats: a summary compiled by the NAO from the agency's data, with funding current to October 2020. It supports flood defence investment and exposure analysis, and relates to the Environment Agency AIMS spatial flood defence asset record in the catalogue.
